product_overview: Guardify IT is a digital subscription e-commerce platform focused on the Bangladesh market, enabling users to purchase premium digital subscriptions, automation scripts, AI tools, and security solutions through a bilingual, mobile-first web application with local mobile payment integration and guest checkout support.
core_goals: Provide instant digital subscription delivery in Bangladesh
Support guest checkout to enable purchases without account registration
Offer a seamless bilingual experience in English and Bengali
Integrate local mobile payment methods (bKash, Nagad, Rocket) for ease of payment
Ensure robust admin capabilities for product, order, and payment management
Deliver a secure and performant platform with user authentication and order tracking
key_features: Product Catalog with filtering by category
Detailed Product Pages with pricing and warranty information
Shopping Cart management with add/remove and subtotal calculations
User Authentication via Supabase with signup, login, and password reset
My Orders view for tracking order status and payment verification
Payment Proof Upload feature for manual payment verification
Wishlist to save and manage favorite products
Admin Dashboard for managing products, orders, categories, and verifying payments
Multi-language support with English and Bengali locales
Contact Form API for user inquiries
Homepage with hero, flash deals, category grid, and product showcases
Integration with Supabase backend for database, auth, and storage
user_flow_summary: Guest Purchase Flow: Browse products, add to cart, checkout with email only, view payment instructions, upload payment proof, admin verifies payment, order completion notification
Registered User Flow: Login or sign up, browse and add products to cart, checkout, pay via mobile banking, upload payment proof, track order status in "My Orders", receive product
Admin Verification Flow: Review new payment proof submissions, verify or reject payment, update order status, notify customer
validation_criteria: Users can browse product catalog and see accurate product details
Guest checkout accepts email only and creates guest user session
Registered users can sign up, login, reset passwords, and manage their orders
Users can upload payment proof screenshots linked to their orders
Admin can verify payment proofs and update order statuses appropriately
Multi-language toggling reflects correct interface translations
Contact form submissions are correctly received and acknowledged
Mobile payment workflows complete successfully with correct order state transitions
UI is responsive and accessible on desktop and mobile devices
API endpoints conform to defined OpenAPI specs and handle error cases gracefully
